$schema: Message Protocol v1.0 — 3 message types for swarm coordination
$doc: Agents communicate by appending messages to swarm-state.json message_log. Lead monitors log, workers self-coordinate.

STATUS.$doc: Worker → Log. Reports progress. No response needed. Lead reads passively.

examples.content: Completed sensor spec extraction for 3 piezoelectric candidates. Starting MEMS comparison.
VDI 2225 evaluation matrix drafted. 5 criteria weighted. Waiting for worker-01 sensor specs to populate scores.

rules: Post STATUS every 2-3 minutes during active work
Include concrete progress (numbers, artifacts), not vague updates
If blocked, switch to REQUEST instead

REQUEST.$doc: Any agent → specific agent or Lead. Asks for help, data, or decision. REQUIRES response.

examples.content: Need piezoelectric sensitivity specs (dB re 1V/µPa) for ICP-type sensors to complete VDI 2225 scoring.
Found conflicting specs for MEMS mic at 140dB SPL. Two sources disagree on max SPL handling. Need decision: use conservative or optimistic spec?

rules: Worker-to-worker REQUESTs for data are preferred over going through Lead
Only escalate to Lead for decisions, conflicts, or unresolvable blocks
If no response within deadline, post escalation to Lead
Lead should resolve REQUESTs within 2 minutes to avoid bottleneck

HANDOFF.$doc: Agent → next agent or task_board. Transfers completed work with context. Moves task to next stage.

examples.content: Sensor comparison research complete. Handing off to shadow for review.
examples.work_completed: Extracted specs for 4 piezoelectric and 3 MEMS microphone candidates meeting BB-01 140dB SPL requirement.
completion_evidence: SPL handling verified against BB-01 requirement (140dB)
Cost data included for Vietnamese supply chain availability
examples.next_action: Shadow agent verifies: (1) all specs sourced from datasheets, (2) elimination criteria correct, (3) top 2 ranking justified
warnings: MEMS-03 spec sheet is from 2022 — may be outdated
Nhật Tảo availability not confirmed for piezo candidates

rules: HANDOFF must include completion_evidence — not just 'I finished'
artifacts must be real file paths, not descriptions
Lead verifies HANDOFF before moving task to 'done'
Shadow agent reviews all HANDOFFs before Lead accepts

routing_rules.worker_to_worker: Allowed for data requests. Reduces Lead bottleneck.
routing_rules.worker_to_lead: Only for decisions, conflicts, task reassignment.
routing_rules.lead_to_worker: Task assignment, conflict resolution, completion verification.
routing_rules.worker_to_shadow: All HANDOFF messages go through shadow first.
